english: \rHello, and welcome to the Pokémon Center.

context: Map 36 (Pokémon League entrance), event 1, page 1: Show Text
english: \rWe restore your tired Pokémon to full health.

context: Map 36 (Pokémon League entrance), event 1, page 1: Show Text
english: \rWould you like to rest your Pokémon?

context: Map 36 (Pokémon League entrance), event 1, page 1: Show Choices option

context: Map 36 (Pokémon League entrance), event 1, page 1: Show Text
english: \rOK, I'll take your Pokémon for a few seconds.

context: Map 36 (Pokémon League entrance), event 1, page 1: Show Text
english: \rYour Pokémon may be infected by Pokérus.

context: Map 36 (Pokémon League entrance), event 1, page 1: Show Text
english: \rLittle is known about the Pokérus except that they are microscopic life-forms that attach to Pokémon.

context: Map 36 (Pokémon League entrance), event 1, page 1: Show Text
english: \rWhile infected, Pokémon are said to grow exceptionally well.

context: Map 36 (Pokémon League entrance), event 1, page 1: Show Text
english: \rThank you for waiting.

context: Map 36 (Pokémon League entrance), event 1, page 1: Show Text
english: \rWe've restored your Pokémon to full health.

context: Map 36 (Pokémon League entrance), event 1, page 1: Show Text; Same text: ev001.p1.c070
english: \rWe hope to see you again!

context: Map 36 (Pokémon League entrance), event 1, page 2: Show Text

context: Map 36 (Pokémon League entrance), event 1, page 2: Show Text
english: \rYour Pokémon have been healed to perfect health.

context: Map 36 (Pokémon League entrance), event 1, page 2: Show Text
english: \rWe hope you excel!

context: Map 36 (Pokémon League entrance), event 5, page 1: Show Text
english: \bBill: Hello! I'm \v[2].

context: Map 36 (Pokémon League entrance), event 5, page 1: Show Text
english: \bI invented the Pokémon Storage System.

context: Map 36 (Pokémon League entrance), event 5, page 1: Show Text
english: \bWhat do you want to know?

context: Map 36 (Pokémon League entrance), event 5, page 1: Show Choices option
english: Wallpapers

context: Map 36 (Pokémon League entrance), event 5, page 1: Show Choices option
english: Cancel

context: Map 36 (Pokémon League entrance), event 5, page 1: Show Text
english: \bAll storage box wallpapers need to be listed in class PokemonStorage, in def allWallpapers.

context: Map 36 (Pokémon League entrance), event 5, page 1: Show Text
english: \bThey correspond to box_0.png, box_1.png, etc. in order without gaps. These images are in the folder Graphics/Pictures/Storage.

context: Map 36 (Pokémon League entrance), event 5, page 1: Show Text
english: \bStorage wallpapers are split into two categories: basic and special.All basic wallpapers are listed before the special wallpapers.

context: Map 36 (Pokémon League entrance), event 5, page 1: Show Text
english: \bBasic wallpapers are always accessible, and boxes use these wallpapers by default. Numbers 0 to 15 inclusive are basic wallpapers.

context: Map 36 (Pokémon League entrance), event 5, page 1: Show Text
english: \bSpecial wallpapers start off locked and unavailable. You can unlock them with pbUnlockWallpaper(id), where id is the wallpaper's number.
